skill.name: notion-automation
skill.description: Use Rube MCP to automate Notion pages, databases, blocks, comments, and user lookups with schema-first workflows.
skill.summary: Automates common Notion workspace tasks through Rube MCP with guidance for schemas, pagination, and content updates.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Most static command findings are false positives caused by Markdown backticks around Rube and Notion tool names. The skill does require a third-party MCP endpoint and can read or change Notion workspace data, including destructive operations. No prompt injection text or hidden execution instructions were found.

remediation.issue: External MCP endpoint handles Notion automation.
remediation.suggestion: Document the third-party data path, required scopes, and privacy expectations before users connect Notion through Rube MCP.

remediation.issue: Destructive Notion actions lack explicit consent guidance.
remediation.suggestion: Require a preview and clear user confirmation before archiving pages, deleting blocks, replacing content, or updating database schemas.
Keep tool names in Markdown, but add a safety note that these are MCP tool identifiers, not shell commands.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Notion connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `notion`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
1. `NOTION_SEARCH_NOTION_PAGE` - Find parent page or existing page [Prerequisite]
2. `NOTION_CREATE_NOTION_PAGE` - Create a new page under a parent [Optional]
4. `NOTION_UPDATE_PAGE` - Update page properties, title, icon, cover [Optional]
- `properties`: Page property values matching parent schema
- `filter`: Filter object matching Notion filter syntax
- `properties`: Property values matching database schema for inserts/updates
1. `NOTION_FETCH_BLOCK_CONTENTS` - Read child blocks of a page [Required]
- Use `content_blocks` parameter, NOT `child_blocks` -- the latter fails validation
- `parent_id`: Parent page ID for new databases
- `properties`: Property definitions with types and options
3. `NOTION_CREATE_COMMENT` - Add a comment to a page [Optional]
- `rich_text`: Comment content as rich text array
- Response data may be nested under `data_preview` or `data.results`
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- 404 object_not_found usually means wrong database_id or the database is not shared with the integr

content.user_title: Automate Notion Workflows with Rube MCP
content.value_statement: Manual Notion updates are slow and easy to miss. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through reliable Rube MCP workflows.
actual_capabilities: Searches Notion pages and databases before acting on workspace objects.
Creates, updates, retrieves, and archives Notion pages through Rube MCP.
Queries databases with filters, sorts, pagination, and exact schema matching.
Appends, replaces, fetches, and deletes page content blocks.
Creates databases and updates database schema definitions.
Lists workspace users and creates or fetches page comments.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Notion OAuth connection.
Can access only pages and databases shared with the Notion integration.
Notion schemas must be fetched before inserts, filters, or updates.
Destructive actions can archive or replace content and should be confirmed first.

use_cases.title: Maintain Project Trackers
use_cases.description: Create project pages, update task rows, and keep database properties aligned with current work.

use_cases.title: Publish Knowledge Base Updates
use_cases.description: Append, replace, or reorganize page content while preserving Notion block structure.

use_cases.title: Audit Workspace Data
use_cases.description: Search pages, query databases, and list comments or users for operational reviews.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Page
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Notion automation skill to find the page named "Weekly Planning". Search tools first, then show the matching page names and IDs.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Database Row
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a new entry after checking the database schema.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the Tasks database, fetch its schema, and add a row for my new task. Ask me for any required fields before inserting.

prompt_templates.title: Update Page Content Safely
prompt_templates.scenario: Modify a page while preserving user control.
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch the content blocks for the Roadmap page. Draft replacement content and ask for confirmation before changing the page.

prompt_templates.title: Query and Summarize Work
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced database query with pagination and filters.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for the Projects database, fetch its schema, then query all active projects by status. Paginate fully and summarize owners, dates, and blockers.

output_examples.input: Find my Launch Plan page and tell me whether it is accessible.
output_examples.output: Found one matching page named Launch Plan. It is shared with the integration and can be retrieved or updated.

output_examples.input: Add three meeting notes to the Team Updates page.
output_examples.output: Prepared three text blocks for Team Updates. I will append them after you confirm the exact page match.

output_examples.input: Show overdue tasks from the Tasks database.
output_examples.output: Fetched the database schema, applied the due-date and status filters, and summarized the overdue tasks by owner.

best_practices: Search Rube tools first so current Notion schemas and parameters are used.
Fetch database schemas before filters, inserts, updates, or schema changes.
Ask for confirmation before archive, delete, replace, or schema update actions.
anti_patterns: Do not assume page or database IDs from names without searching first.
Do not ignore pagination when reading database rows or search results.
Do not update read-only Notion properties such as formula or rollup fields.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Notion API key?
faq.answer: No. It uses Rube MCP and a Notion OAuth connection managed through Rube.

faq.question: Can it access every page in my workspace?
faq.answer: No. It can access only pages and databases shared with the connected Notion integration.

faq.question: Can it permanently delete Notion content?
faq.answer: The documented delete and archive actions usually set archived status. Users should still confirm before destructive changes.

faq.question: Why should tools be searched first?
faq.answer: Rube MCP schemas can change. Searching tools first helps use current parameter names and supported actions.

faq.question: Can it create new databases?
faq.answer: Yes. It can create databases under shared parent pages and define properties based on Notion schema rules.

faq.question: Does it work with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools when Rube MCP is available.
